import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        
        // The maximum number of spider-free cells is n*m - ceil(n*m/5)
        // Because each spider can cover at most 5 cells (itself and 4 neighbors)
        // So minimum number of occupied cells is ceil(n*m/5)
        int total = n * m;
        int minOccupied = (total + 4) / 5; // This is ceil(total/5)
        int maxFree = total - minOccupied;
        
        System.out.println(maxFree);
    }
}
